note: What a face-down card in the bag says about the class under it, beside its scrambled name (InventoryScreen.locked_hint). Very short: seven words at most. ⚠ No line may name any of the fifty, in English or Filipino, nor mention ink -- run_book_probe reads every one.

hints.circle: Round, with no corners at all.
hints.square: Four equal sides and four corners.
hints.bird: Feathers, wings and a sweet song.
hints.bat: Flies at night, hangs upside down.
hints.spider: Eight legs, and it spins a web.
hints.frog: Green, hops, and croaks by ponds.
hints.shark: Sharp teeth, a fin above the waves.
hints.octopus: Eight long arms under the sea.
hints.horse: Gallops fast, and pulls a cart.
hints.elephant: Huge, grey, with a long trunk.
hints.sea_turtle: Swims with flippers, wears a shell.
hints.snail: Slow, with its home on its back.
hints.ant: Tiny, strong, marches in a line.
hints.pig: Curly tail, snorts, rolls in mud.
hints.penguin: Black and white; slides on ice.
hints.scorpion: Pincers in front, a stinger behind.
hints.axe: A heavy blade for chopping wood.
hints.sword: A long, sharp blade for battle.
hints.cannon: Booms, and fires heavy iron balls.
hints.boomerang: Throw it, and it comes back.
hints.flashlight: A light you carry in your hand.
hints.campfire: Flames to sit around at night.
hints.cloud: Floats in the sky and brings rain.
hints.sun: Shines bright and warm by day.
hints.fan: Spinning blades that make a breeze.
hints.ladder: Rungs to climb, one by one.
hints.stairs: Steps that lead to the next floor.
hints.parachute: Opens wide to slow a fall.
hints.hot_air_balloon: Rises on warm air with a basket.
hints.bridge: Carries a path across a river.
hints.sailboat: Pushed across the water by wind.
hints.key: Turns in a lock to open it.
hints.anvil: A heavy iron block for hammering.
hints.umbrella: Keeps you dry in the rain.
hints.tree: Tall trunk, branches and green leaves.
hints.bread: Baked from flour, sliced for toast.
hints.wheel: Round, and turns on an axle.
